ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( AND( ISCHANGED(GenerateLicense__c), GenerateLicense__c = true, NOT(ISPICKVAL(Phase__c,"H - License Generation")), OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type__c,"ADDC - Additional Class")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type__c,"RNEW - Renewal")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type__c,"LICN - New License")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type__c,"REAC - Reactivation")) ) ), true, false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A License can only be generated if the Phase is "H - License Generation" and type is a ADDC, RNEW, LICN or REAC
